summary: Remove isolated nodes that were not migrated to execution nodes by stopping automation-controller-service and running awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=<host> from another instance.
questions: How do I deprovision an isolated node?
Should I use awx-manage to remove execution nodes?

answer_card.title: Deprovision an isolated node with awx-manage
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
# on the node
automation-controller-service stop
# from another instance
awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=<host_name>
```
Only for isolated nodes; remove execution nodes with the installer (`node_state=deprovision`).
